versions.content: Categories for RunnableEntityGroup in a Blueprint of Con- sistencyNeeds ALL_RUNNABLES_OF_COMPONENT RunnableEntityGroup of the Consisten- cyNeeds shall contain all RunnableEntity s of the software component. ALL_RUNNABLES_WRITING_TO_DATA_PROTOTYP_GROUP RunnableEntity- Group of the ConsistencyNeeds shall contain all RunnableEntity s with a implicit write access to any of the VariableDataPrototype s in the attached DataPrototypeGroup . ALL_RUNNABLES_READING_FROM_DATA_PROTOTYPE_GROUP RunnableEntity- Group of the ConsistencyNeeds shall contain all RunnableEntity s with a implicit read access to any of the VariableDataPrototype s in the attached DataPrototypeGroup . ALL_RUNNABLES_WRITING_TO_OR_READING_FROM_DATA_PROTOTYPE_GROUP RunnableEntityGroup of the ConsistencyNeed shall contain all RunnableEn- tity s with a implicit write or read access to any of the VariableDataProto- type s in the attached DataPrototypeGroup .
